item.description:
Thimble 0.9.1 makes a project's Overview easier to read on every device.
- Notes and docs have more room between paragraphs, lists, and headings, and between the lines of a long paragraph. - Questions, each pinned doc, and Pictures have the same clear header on the Overview, which opens them. - A pinned doc's words sit in a panel of their own, so its headings never read as the project's. - Android: the Overview shows a project's notes formatted, as on the Mac and iPhone. Tap them to edit, and tick their checkboxes. - Bucket sync: a misspelled bucket name on Cloudflare R2 now says to check the name, not only the key's permissions.
